references.text: The command to maintain an eternal ordinance throughout all generations is also found in connection with the Passover meal.
The prohibition against eating from the new harvest before the firstfruits offering has been brought is repeated here.
Instructions to count seven weeks from when the sickle is put to the grain, marking the beginning of the harvest.
The Israelites ate from the produce of the land after celebrating Passover, and the manna ceased when they began to eat from the crops of Canaan.
Description of a firstfruits offering with fresh stalks, roasted grain, and new grain (karmel), using the same words as in the verse.
Regulations concerning the offering of firstfruits when the people enter the land where they are to live.
